minutes.headline: Personnel Committee finished the Salary Administration Plan rewrite and voted to accept it, plus a new COA van driver hire.
minutes.summary: The committee approved a Council on Aging van driver hire at a set grade and step, then went through the final tracked-changes Salary Administration Plan bylaw revisions section by section. It restored two provisions (hires above step one need committee approval; summer vacation entitlement by seniority), dropped the FMLA attachment, and voted to accept the revised plan. Much of the time went to Zoom screen-share and connection problems.

what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee voted to accept the revised Salary Administration Plan after a section-by-section review of the final tracked changes.
The committee restored struck language letting employees use at least 40 hours of vacation between June 1 and September 15, by seniority.
It voted to remove the Family Medical Leave Act attachment from the plan; the policy will be posted on the town HR web page instead.
The committee approved a Council on Aging van driver hire at grade four, step three.
Positions covered by the police contract will carry an asterisk rather than a grade; the civilian traffic position is to be handled in the fall.

why_it_matters: The Salary Administration Plan sets the pay grades and steps for town employees, so its wording shapes what the town budget, mostly taxes, pays for those positions.
The van driver hire at a set grade and step is a personnel cost that falls on the Council on Aging's line in the town budget.

A town meeting article adding new positions to the salary grid; the civilian traffic position is to be added in the fall (t=2818).
